author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Check out Flox ➜ https://learnlinux.link/flox

In this video, we’ll install Flox, build a Python environment in minutes, then push and pull it from FloxHub so your whole team runs the exact same stack. Along the way you’ll see where Flox fits into your SDLC and how it uses Nix under the hood to kill dependency hell for good.

No containers. No "works on my machine." Just one environment that follows your project anywhere.
